name: AKS Cluster and Workload Destruction
description: AKS clusters, pods, and network policies are the running application. Deleting the cluster, mass-deleting pods, or opening/closing network policy can take the product down or isolate it for ransom. Creating a throwaway cluster can also be a staging ground. These are blunt impact actions, not subtle identity changes. Cluster delete and bulk pod delete should match a maintenance window.
mitigations: Rotate credentials if the actor is compromised
